## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated regression tests.
- [ ] Ran <code>ruff check .</code>.
- [ ] Ran <code>ruff format --check .</code>.
- [ ] Ran <code>pytest</code>.
- [ ] Ran <code>python -m compileall -q src tests</code>.
- [ ] Ran <code>node --check website/app.js</code> if website code changed.
- [ ] Updated documentation or roadmap where appropriate.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private customer data are included.
- [ ] No untrusted pull-request code is executed by the API or analysis workflow.
- [ ] Any API/schema or configuration changes are documented.
- [ ] Limitations and failure modes are described honestly.
